title: Time Jump — 08:40, Forensic Verification and Restore Timeline

fields.narration: Facilitator: It is now 08:40 on Tuesday, March 3, 2026. The forensic firm has confirmed that the immutable cloud copy of the EHR database contains a clean snapshot from 02:00 — before the intruder logged on. The domain controllers have not been rebuilt. The EHR vendor confirms that the earliest the CareLine EHR could be restored is 04:00 on Wednesday, March 4, 2026. About 3 hours and 40 minutes of patient documentation, including all medication records, lab results, and imaging reports, exist only on paper or in the encrypted database. The EHR remains offline. The ISO has not yet initiated the restore sequence.
worldState: The immutable cloud copy of the EHR database is verified as clean and pre-intrusion (02:00).
The domain controllers have not been rebuilt and the network remains in a degraded state.
The EHR vendor confirms the earliest possible restore time is 04:00 on Wednesday, March 4, 2026.
Approximately 3 hours and 40 minutes of patient documentation are only available on paper or in the encrypted database.
The EHR remains offline and no restore has been initiated.
The ISO has not yet begun the restore sequence per C1.

instructorNote: This time jump confirms the pre-intrusion baseline and establishes the restore timeline. Watch for the ISO to initiate the restore sequence and for the CNO to re-engage the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026).
